# 2 Baruch Chapter 9 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** The Fall of Jerusalem

---

**1** And I Baruch came and sat down before the gate of the temple and wept and mourned, and I cried out and said: "O Lord, why have you set fire to your vineyard and laid waste to your land, and why have you given to destruction the plantation of your right hand?

**2** And all the prophets of your people who are left are being led away into captivity, and there is no one left here to comfort your servant Baruch."

---

*LOGOS notes: "Vineyard" for Israel echoes Isa 5:1-7 and Ps 80. "Plantation of your right hand" is Ps 80:15. The lament formula concludes the first section of the narrative.*
